description: The runs the training pipeline exports (Phase 18; system scenarios only since Phase 21). Ten seeds each from the scenario's own seed: the urban baseline (military_urban_001 v0.2) and its two doctrine alternatives, three severe stresses of the baseline, the four military reference scenarios, the airspace and the city scenario; plus two batches for STARTX branch evaluation. Measured before commit: 46 clean, 27 risky, 47 rejected; 7 genuine successes, 4 false successes.
